counterfactual_missing_items: No explicit nerve bundle involvement described
No myxoid stroma or rapid onset to support nodular fasciitis
decisive_items: subcutaneous enlargement of the right side of her nose and right cheek
Mature adipocytes extending into skeletal tissue
response.rationale: C1 is the most complete specific diagnosis: it includes R2's fibrolipomatous hamartoma histology and adds the anatomically supported right nose/cheek distribution. R2 is accurate but lacks the anatomical qualifier. R5 is too generic and lacks nerve-specific evidence; the other candidates either have no raw support or are contradicted by the histopathology.

rejected.why: Initial sebaceous hyperplasia interpretation was superseded by the review showing fibroadipose and spindle-cell proliferation.
Broad nerve tissue tumor label lacks nerve sheath-specific raw evidence and is less specific than fibrolipomatous hamartoma.
No raw support; Madelung disease has symmetric lipomatosis, not the described unilateral fibroadipose spindle-cell lesion.
Only nonspecific skin thickening; histology with mature adipocytes, spindle cells, and collagen fragments is not scleroderma.
No raw support; 10-year indolent course and mature adipocytic infiltration are incompatible with nodular fasciitis.
